gaps.description: AICoin API credentials missing (5 env vars). Service runs but falls back to free-tier/no-API-call mode. Whale wall data from AICoin API unavailable.
gaps.impact: Whale wall order book data from AICoin API not feeding trainer or website. Free-tier symbol scores written from other sources.
gaps.fix: Set AICOIN_ACCESS_KEY_ID, AICOIN_ACCESS_SECRET, AICOIN_API_KEY, AICOIN_API_SECRET, AICOIN_API_BASE_URL in env

gaps.description: LunarCrush credential status not confirmed at audit time. Service active but whether credential is valid is unknown.
gaps.impact: Social/sentiment scores may be missing or stale
gaps.fix: Verify LUNARCRUSH_API_KEY in env; check redis-cli get 'v2:altdata:lunarcrush:status'

gaps.description: Nansen credential status not confirmed at audit time.
gaps.impact: On-chain flow features may be missing
gaps.fix: Verify NANSEN_API_KEY in env; check redis-cli get 'v2:altdata:nansen:status'
